components.description: Component definitions for Atomic Client Entity. Flat component storage with no groups or events.

description.description: Description metadata for Atomic Client Entity. Molang expressions are recognized under blend_expression, blend_value, initialize, on_entry, on_exit, pre_animation, events, and transitions. Queries are unsupported. Random/die-roll operations are unsupported in continuously evaluated expressions and may be used in one-shot hooks. Value expressions allow read-only operations, while initialize, pre_animation, and event hooks may assign variables. Animation expressions can read context.key_frame_lerp_fraction, a [0, 1] interpolation fraction.
